evals.prompt: /graph-automation "Audit every Python script in ./tools for functions with no docstring and produce a report" --output reports/docstring-audit.md --sources tools --checks "report has one section per file::test $(grep -c '^## ' reports/docstring-audit.md) -ge 1" --limit 8 --auto
evals.expected_output: An automations/<slug>/ bundle with graph.md (approved spec: at least one code node for the deterministic scan, model nodes for judgment, a code merge node), checks.md with gate rows and completion, progress.md with next action, and reports/docstring-audit.md produced by a code node; graphify-out built for ./tools; final message states what passed and what is unresolved.

evals.prompt: I want this done as a graph of bounded nodes with gates like the autoresearch setup: write release notes for everything that changed in src/ since the last tag, output to docs/RELEASE.md. Don't start until I've approved the node graph.
evals.expected_output: graphify maps src/, graph.md is written with nodes/edges/checks and the session pauses for approval before any node runs; after approval the loop runs, every node gate is recorded in checks.md, docs/RELEASE.md is written by a code merge node, progress.md is updated.

Reads automations/docstring-audit/graph.md and progress.md first, runs graphctl status, continues from the recorded next action without re-running passed nodes, and finishes with graphctl complete and an updated progress.md.
